heading: India Bond Yields Above 7%: A Sweet Spot for 3-5 Year Debt Funds
tldr: Indian bond yields have risen above 7%, making debt investments potentially more attractive.
This higher yield environment particularly benefits debt funds investing in the 3-5 year maturity segment.
Funds focusing on high-quality corporate bonds and State Development Loans (SDLs) within this segment are recommended.
Investors can benefit from both higher accrual income and potential capital gains if interest rates eventually decline.
Long-duration debt funds carry higher interest rate risk and may be less suitable in the current volatile environment.
caption:
Ever wondered if there's a good time to invest in debt? Right now, Indian bond yields are over 7%, which means debt investments are looking more attractive. This is especially true for funds that invest in bonds maturing in 3-5 years. You could get steady income and possibly even make extra money if rates drop later. Learn more about this opportunity in our latest article.
